run_sequence_prediction_demo: run the AI4Animation sequence prediction demo to train an MLP on motion data and predict future poses
create_dataset_with_modules: create a Dataset with RootModule, MotionModule, and MirrorModule to load and preprocess motion capture data
build_mlp_network: build a MultiLayerPerceptron model with configurable input, output, and hidden dimensions for motion prediction
extract_training_features: extract input and output tensors from motion batches using bone transformations and velocities for training
draw_predicted_motion: draw predicted future root trajectory and bone motion series from network output tensors
